tasks.short: Establish and supervise peer counselling and tutoring

steps.what: Establish peer-counseling and peer-tutoring scope, safeguards and supervision arrangements
Prepare peer supporters and supervise programme delivery

tasks.design: Keep programme design and supervision with the counsellor, with agreed safeguards recorded in {DOCS}. Reuse authorised reference material but do not turn peer support into automated counselling or claim that existing document access saves new time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme boundaries and peer readiness require local professional judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: No new tool removes the need to assess support needs and supervise peers.
tasks.still_hard: Preventing peers from taking on responsibilities beyond their training and noticing harm early.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor can recognise uncertainty, support the peer and take over a sensitive situation.
tasks.altitude: Programme responsibility and supervision time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Recognise when peer support should be escalated
reach.learn: Safeguarding boundaries and named escalation routes

evidence.claim: Peer-support programme design and supervision require contextual safeguards and feedback; this unchanged design has no measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary is establishing and supervising programmes, not a separate calendar administration task.
Counsellor produces the programme plan and escalation arrangements in s1 before s2 uses them. No machine-readable readiness scores are assumed.
Check existing native reference and programme tools before any future custom build.
No new software, automatic matching or dataset is introduced; incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Local safeguarding responsibilities and training requirements
Whether counselling and tutoring need separate programme rules
research_questions: Which programme failures arise from unclear peer boundaries rather than missing software?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100 with zero upkeep give zero saving. Both programme establishment and recurring peer supervision keep their time; no scheduling baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe students and evaluate development in context

steps.what: Observe students during classroom and play activities
Evaluate students' performance, behavior, social development, and physical health

tasks.design: Retain direct observation and professional interpretation; authorised context in {DOCS} remains a reference. Do not substitute video analysis, behavioural scoring or diagnostic inference for seeing students in context.
tasks.previous_blocker: A brief behaviour can have several explanations, and observation conditions matter.
tasks.enabler_now: No established capability in the digest justifies removing this observation time.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing transient behaviour from a concern requiring follow-up without overinterpreting it.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor can notice context, reconsider an impression and seek appropriate specialist input.
tasks.altitude: Observation time and professional responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.role: child, family, and school social worker
reach.learn: Objective descriptions, uncertainty and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Direct student observation and contextual interpretation cannot be replaced merely by configuring a records tool; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is observation and evaluation, not subsequent record administration or diagnosis. The occupational statement grants no medical authority.
Counsellor produces contextual observations in s1 before interpreting them in s2; no structured behavioural labels or automatic health inference are required.
Native reference access should be checked before custom code; current runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero upkeep follows from introducing no new process, recording device or software.
unknowns: Local permissions for observation and access to student context
research_questions: How do counsellors separate observed facts from interpretations and record uncertainty?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero upkeep give zero saving. Routine and concerning observations both retain their time; unrelated record drafting is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sponsor clubs, student organisations and academic contests

steps.what: Agree extracurricular activities and record practical arrangements
Prepare, check and send extracurricular calendar invitations
Sponsor clubs, student organizations, and academic contests in person

tasks.design: Configure reusable invitation drafts in {CALENDAR} from an activity brief recorded in {DOCS}. The counsellor checks timing, recipients and arrangements before sending, and retains all activity decisions and sponsorship time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring activity details are copied into invitations individually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recurring events and draft reuse can reduce repetitive entry without selecting activities or supervising students.
tasks.still_hard: Making an activity inclusive and responding to student needs during it.
tasks.human_edge: The sponsor notices exclusion, builds confidence and changes an activity when circumstances require it.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated invitation entry; sponsorship authority remains unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare an activity invitation for sponsor review
reach.learn: Recipient permissions, accessibility and change handling

evidence.claim: Native calendar templates and recurring events can reduce repeated invitation entry; this allocation and saving are modelled rather than measured.

assumptions: Boundary includes practical coordination and live sponsorship; it excludes separate student counselling.

Counsellor in s1 captures activity title, start, end, time zone, location, organiser, permitted recipient group, accessibility arrangements and recurrence limits. Its full 20 hours include agreeing and entering those fields.

In s2 native configuration prepares a draft only. Counsellor checks the actual recipient expansion, time, location and accessibility wording before sending; incomplete briefs are entered manually within retained review/exception time.
Use native calendar configuration first; only incremental copying reduction is credited, not existing calendar runtime.
Sponsorship and practical supervision in s3 keep all 65 hours.
unknowns: Availability of native templates and permitted student recipient groups
research_questions: Can recurring invitations reduce preparation while preserving checks for holidays, changed locations and recipient access?

already_counted.description: Invitation checks, manual exceptions and send decision

incremental.description: Maintain invitation defaults and resolve recurrence exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact invitation draft with expanded recipients, title, times, zone, location, accessibility text and recurrence; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=20+6+65=91; gross 9 less 1 upkeep gives central net 8. High assumes reusable recurring activities; low assumes only 1 hour removed because one-off changes require manual entry, consumed by upkeep. Live sponsorship retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep programme design, student observation and live sponsorship; reduce repeated activity invitation entry where native configuration helps.
reach: Help support staff prepare checked activity arrangements within agreed access boundaries
role.ambitious_version: A counsellor who can give attention to students and peer supporters while keeping practical arrangements clear and checked.

job.title: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
